description: List open Jira issues assigned to the authenticated user, optionally limited to one project. Use this to find what to work on next. Pass jql to search with your own filter instead (e.g. "type = Bug AND sprint in openSprints() ORDER BY priority DESC"); it is limited to projectKey when given, and to the allowed projects when the strict allowlist is on. When more results exist, data.nextPageToken is set: pass it back as pageToken for the next page.

jql.description: JQL filter replacing the default "my open issues" query

projectKey.description: Project key to search (e.g. ENG). Defaults to the configured default project.

name: jira_search_issues
title: Search Jira issues
